about_the_game:
NOTICE: Our game currently REQUIRES two xbox controllers to play.
We are working on improving controller options, but currently only xbox works correctly.
To play online, please use Steam remote play.

The Purrfect Competitive Game!

OVERCAT is a local multiplayer 1v1 brawler. The game hopes to bring a beginner-friendly competitive experience, where being better or worse than your opponent can make the match even better.

We all hate losing over and over again to that friend you simply don't have a chance of beating, and when you are that friend, it sure is boring when your superior skills aren't challenged...

But OVERCAT is here to fix that problem!

OVERCATS vs UNDERCATS

OVERCAT features a special mechanic to bring a twist to your typical fighter.
At the start of each round you can choose between playing as an Overcat or an Undercat.

The Overcat is far stronger than the Undercat, so if you want the best odds at winning, the Overcat is the obvious choice… right?

However! If you manage to beat an Overcat as an Undercat, they gain double the points!

Are you confident you can beat the other player? Go Undercat to capitalise on the victory!

Think the other player’s pushing their luck? Go Overcat and punish their overconfidence!

It's just as much a mental game as it is a physical one! Can you prove yourself the top cat?

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Win 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i7 or equivalent
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: RTX 3070
  • Storage: 6 GB available space
